# Commands Electron desktop shell, branding, and build-capable worktrees

Run Thunderbird `mach` from the Firefox/Gecko root, never directly from `comm`. `AUTOCLOBBER=1` and `MOZ_SKIP_PATH_PERFORMANCE_CHECK=1` are injected by Commands; use independent object directories and immutable compatibility-keyed completed snapshots. [Task 2]

Scope: console.
